problem_statement:
MySQL Bug 37570206: REVOKE and REVOKE ALL apply restrictions inconsistently.

A grantor cannot revoke a grantee's privileges when the grantor has schema restrictions that the grantee does not have, or the grantee has fewer restrictions on the same schema. These rules are not applied consistently by REVOKE and REVOKE ALL; REVOKE EXECUTE can raise ERROR 3879. Equivalent revocations should enforce the same restrictions.
